metadata.case_title: M/s Orient Textiles Ltd. vs. Province of Sindh & Others
metadata.judge_names: Mr. Justice Tariq Mehmood Jahangiri, Mr. Justice Arshad Hussain
metadata.brief_summary: Constitutional petition challenging illegal recovery notices issued by provincial tax authorities. The Court granted an interim stay against account freezing subject to a partial deposit.

actions.action_required: Deposit 15% of the disputed demand (PKR 4.5 Million) in the shape of pay order or bank guarantee with the Nazir of this Court.
actions.deadline_text: Within 10 days from the date of this order
actions.condition: Prerequisite to maintain interim protective order.
actions.consequence_risk: Interim stay shall stand automatically vacated without further notice to the petitioner, and recovery proceedings will resume.

source_citation.verbatim_quote: The petitioner shall deposit 15% of the impugned tax demand with the Nazir of this Court within ten (10) days from today, failing which the interim relief granted herein shall cease to operate.

actions.action_required: Immediately de-freeze all commercial bank accounts of the petitioner and refrain from coercive recovery steps.
actions.deadline_text: Within 24 hours of receiving proof of deposit from Nazir
actions.condition: Contingent upon Petitioner complying with ACT-01.
actions.consequence_risk: Initiation of Contempt of Court proceedings under Article 204 of the Constitution against the Commissioner.

source_citation.verbatim_quote: Upon submission of the Nazir's compliance certificate, Respondent No. 2 is directed to defreeze the bank accounts within 24 hours without fail.

actions.action_required: Submit detailed parawise comments and counter-affidavit along with relevant administrative records.
actions.deadline_text: Within 3 weeks from receipt of court notice
actions.consequence_risk: Ex-parte proceedings will be ordered and right to file written statement shall stand forfeited.

source_citation.verbatim_quote: Issue notice to respondents. Parawise comments be filed within three weeks positively.

actions.action_required: Fix the matter for regular hearing before the division bench on the next assigned cause list.
